visuals: Dense, green tropical rainforest in the Colombian Amazon with sunlight filtering through the trees.
script: Now for the landscape, Colombia is like a nature party! It’s got tropical jungles.

visuals: Snowy peaks of the Colombian Andes mountains under a clear blue sky.
script: Snowy Andes peaks.

visuals: A sunny Caribbean coastline in Colombia with white sand beaches and palm trees.
script: And sunny beachy coastlines.

visuals: A map illustration of Colombia showing the Andes mountain range splitting into three distinct branches (Occidental, Central, and Oriental).
script: Here’s the best twist: the Andes Mountains split into not one, not two, but THREE ranges as they cross Colombia. That means tons of rivers, steep valleys, and super cool hiking trails.

visuals: A wide view of the Magdalena River in Colombia with small wooden boats and locals fishing along the banks.
script: Speaking of rivers, meet the Magdalena: it’s like Colombia’s watery highway! People farm, fish, and travel along it every day. Floaty and functional!

visuals: A massive Andean condor soaring high above the rugged mountain cliffs of Colombia.
script: Now keep your eyes on the sky! The Andean condor, a giant bird with wings that stretch wider than a car, is Colombia’s national animal!

visuals: A rare pink river dolphin leaping from the freshwater of the Colombian Amazon.
script: And deep in the Amazon waters you might spot a pink river dolphin! Yup, it’s real—and it only lives in freshwater. Now that’s one fashionable creature.

visuals: A high-altitude view of Bogotá, Colombia, with its red brick buildings, historic center, and colorful street murals.
script: Have you ever heard of Bogotá? It’s Colombia’s capital and it’s way up in the mountains! Bet you didn’t think a city could be high up and full of libraries and street art!

visuals: A festive parade in Medellín, Colombia, with people carrying large, circular flower arrangements (silleteros).
script: Just a short trip away is Medellín, where flowers bloom in many seasons thanks to its spring-like weather! They even have a giant flower festival with colorful parades.

visuals: The historic city of Cartagena, Colombia, with its well-preserved colonial stone walls and colorful buildings.
script: And over on the coast? Cartagena, with its colorful forts and old city walls—it’s like a history book you can walk through!

visuals: A quiet, colonial street in Villa de Leyva, Colombia, with its large stone-paved plaza and whitewashed buildings.
script: Colombia’s official language is Spanish, but wait in different regions, people also speak Wayuu, Embera, and Creole.

visuals: A pleasant afternoon at the Plaza de Bolívar in Bogotá, Colombia, with people walking past the historic cathedral and justice palace.
script: Colombia has a large population, approximately 53 million, about the same as Spain, and it’s still growing.

visuals: Warm Colombian arepas (corn cakes) stuffed with melted cheese and a fried egg on a traditional ceramic plate.
script: Time to taste Colombia! Arepas are warm corn cakes, sometimes stuffed with eggs, cheese, or both. Yum squared!

visuals: A steaming bowl of authentic Colombian ajiaco soup with chicken, corn, and potatoes, served with avocado slices.
script: Ajiaco is a cozy chicken and potato soup, perfect when you’re up in chilly mountains.

visuals: A burlap sack of fresh Colombian coffee beans, a steaming cup of coffee, and a bundle of vibrant tropical flowers on a wooden table.
script: And don’t forget what Colombia’s famous for: coffee! It’s one of the top producers in the world. And flowers? Colombians grow so many they ship them worldwide!

visuals: A group of dancers in traditional Colombian attire performing the cumbia with drums in a town square.
script: Now get ready to dance with cumbia music styles packed with drums, and joyful vibes.

visuals: Musicians playing the accordion and drums to the rhythm of vallenato music in a sunny Colombian courtyard.
script: And vallenato music packed with accordions.

visuals: The vibrant Barranquilla Carnival in Colombia with participants in elaborate masks and colorful costumes under a shower of confetti.
script: And get this, the Barranquilla Carnival is one of South America’s biggest parties! Costumes, dancing, music; it’s like a giant glitter-filled explosion of fun!

visuals: Colombian fans in a stadium celebrating a victory, waving the yellow, blue, and red national flag.
script: Colombia reached the quarterfinals in the 2014 World Cup, their best result as of 2024. Go team!

visuals: Colombian soccer star James Rodríguez celebrating a goal on the pitch.
script: And speaking of soccer, James Rodríguez became world-famous as the tournament’s top scorer!

visuals: Global pop superstar Shakira performing on a stage during a concert in Colombia.
script: Oh, and pop superstar Shakira? She was born right in Barranquilla!

visuals: An aerial view of the Caño Cristales river in Colombia, known as the liquid rainbow, with its vibrant red, yellow, and green underwater plants.
script: Here’s a colorful fact: in Caño Cristales, aquatic plants make the river shine in five different colors during certain months. It’s nicknamed “The Liquid Rainbow!”
